dashboard.title: Queues live dashboard
dashboard.description: Choose a queue to inspect its observed calls and configured agents.
dashboard.coverage: Compared observations from known ACDC replicas, not an atomic cluster snapshot or verified telephony occupancy. Partial sources withhold counts. Agent eligibility is not inferred; refresh requests another observation.

sourceReasons.source_timeout: Not every source responded in time

dashboard.staleHelp: This snapshot is over 30 seconds old, its refresh failed or its update connection was lost. A recent response does not prove fresh source observations; check the source and update status.

transports.unavailable: Native updates are unavailable for this response. Use Refresh for another authorized snapshot.
transports.empty: No queues to subscribe to on this page. The authorized page is reconciled every 15 seconds.
transports.connecting: Native subscription acknowledgement pending. Snapshots are also reconciled every 15 seconds.
transports.acknowledged: Native subscription acknowledged. Events request a fresh snapshot; acknowledgement is not a broker binding barrier or replay. Reconciliation runs every 15 seconds.
transports.disconnected: Native updates disconnected. Retained values are stale; authorized snapshot reconciliation continues every 15 seconds.
transports.error: Native subscription unavailable or rejected. Retained values are stale; authorized snapshot reconciliation continues every 15 seconds.

dashboard.refreshFailed: Refresh failed. The previous snapshot is shown; no values have been replaced with zero.
dashboard.searchQueues: Find a queue on this page
dashboard.noMatchingQueues: No queue names on this page match your search.
dashboard.recentSubset: Observed record counts, not list-row counts
dashboard.queueMissing: Queue no longer in the inventory
dashboard.queueMissingHelp: Return to all queues to choose a currently configured queue.
dashboard.inventoryUnavailable: This queue observation page could not be loaded or verified. Access may have changed. Try again; no empty inventory is being assumed.
dashboard.statsUnavailable: Queue observations are unavailable or invalid. Unknown counts are shown as —, not zero.
dashboard.rosterUnavailable: This queue’s configured roster could not be verified.
dashboard.namesUnavailable: Agent names could not be loaded. Verified roster identifiers are shown where necessary.
dashboard.statusUnavailable: Global agent statuses could not be refreshed. No availability is inferred.
dashboard.callsContext: Only waiting and in-progress records for this queue, ordered by entry time (not queue position). Durations use the end of the observed replica window and do not keep ticking. Caller identity and assigned-agent details are not supplied by this endpoint.
dashboard.callsTruncated: Showing the first 200 observed active records, oldest first. This list is truncated; cards use the full observed counts, not displayed rows.
dashboard.membersTruncated: Showing the first 200 configured agents in roster order. The configured-agent count includes the full verified roster.
dashboard.noObservedCalls: No active records were returned for this queue. This does not prove the queue is empty.
dashboard.memberContext: Only this queue’s configured roster. Global status does not confirm queue login, endpoint reachability or eligibility to receive a call.
dashboard.noMembers: No agents are configured in this queue’s roster.
dashboard.recentCallsWindow: Last 24 hours, up to 20 newest outcomes.
dashboard.noCalls: No recent call statistics are available.
dashboard.partialTitle: Some live data is temporarily unavailable.

partial.statuses: Agent presence could not be refreshed.

partial.agentStats: Agent performance statistics could not be refreshed.

queues.title: Queues
queues.description: Create routing queues, tune call handling, and assign multiple agents.
queues.formDescription: Queue settings are validated by the Kazoo ACDC API.
queues.rosterHelp: Select every user who should belong to this queue.
queues.agentOrderHelp: Try one eligible agent at a time in this order. Busy or unavailable agents are skipped. Newly added members appear after the existing priority list.
queues.strategyHelp: Round robin, most idle, and in order each ring one eligible agent at a time. Ring all rings every eligible responding agent; there is no numeric parallel-ring limit.
queues.agentOrderReadOnly: The complete roster or an existing priority entry is unavailable. Priority changes are disabled and the saved order is preserved.
queues.rosterUnavailable: The current roster could not be loaded. Agent membership is read-only until it can be refreshed.
queues.rosterReadOnlyHelp: Roster updates are disabled to protect the existing membership. Retry the page to edit agents.
queues.incompleteInventory: The complete agent inventory could not be verified. Existing queue membership is protected; reload after resolving the missing or partial inventory.
queues.routeHelp: Optional. Calls to this internal extension enter the queue. Leave it blank to create no app-managed route.
queues.routeUnavailable: Callflow routes could not be verified. Extension changes are disabled to protect existing routing.
queues.routeReadOnlyHelp: Extension changes are disabled until every ACDC callflow can be verified.
queues.externalRoutes: Externally managed route(s) already reach this queue and will not be changed. Extensions:
queues.routeCollision: That extension is already assigned to another callflow. Choose a different extension.
queues.routeSavedFailed: Queue settings and roster were saved, but the internal extension was not.
queues.routeOwnershipChanged: The managed route no longer has the expected ownership and shape. It was not changed.
queues.externalRouteDeleteBlocked: This queue is still referenced by an externally managed ACDC callflow. Remove that route explicitly before deleting the queue.
queues.multipleManagedRoutes: Multiple app-managed routes reference this queue. No route was changed; resolve the duplicate routes first.
queues.statsUnavailable: Live queue counters are temporarily unavailable. Queue configuration is still editable.
queues.emptyDescription: Create a queue to begin assigning agents and receiving calls.
queues.confirmDelete: Delete queue “{{name}}”? This cannot be undone.
queues.savedSettingsOnly: Queue settings saved. The existing agent roster was preserved.
queues.savedRoutePreserved: Queue and agent roster saved. Existing callflow routing was preserved.
queues.savedMissingId: The queue was saved, but the API did not return its identifier. Refresh queues before retrying.
queues.savedRosterFailed: The queue was saved, but its agent roster was not.

agents.title: Agents
agents.globalStatusHelp: Global Ready does not confirm login to a particular queue. Choose Login to check or log in to an existing configured queue.
agents.chooseQueueHelp: Choose one of this agent’s configured queues. Logging in does not assign a new roster membership or log out any other agent or queue.
agents.noEligibleQueues: No eligible configured queue was found. Assign the agent through the queue roster before requesting queue login.
agents.queueInventoryUnavailable: The complete configured queue inventory could not be verified. No login was requested; close and reload to retry.
agents.queuePendingCheckAgain: Login is still pending. Check again for runtime confirmation; no additional login request has been sent.
agents.queueProofUnavailable: Queue runtime confirmation is unavailable. No confirmed queue login is being reported.
agents.queueRequestUncertain: The login response could not be verified. The request may still be processing; check its status before retrying.
agents.queueConfirmationHelp: Confirmation proves this agent belongs to the selected runtime queue. It does not prove the endpoint will ring or that the agent is currently available. Confirmation expires after 30 seconds unless checked again.
agents.description: Control agent sessions and inspect recent performance across queue memberships.
agents.statsUnavailable: Current status or performance counters could not be refreshed. Agent controls remain available.
agents.emptyDescription: Add users to a queue roster to manage their ACDC status here.

dropdowns.incomplete: Some choices could not be completely verified. Affected selectors are read-only and existing values are preserved. Reload before changing those settings.
dropdowns.currentPreserved: Keep current custom or unavailable value
dropdowns.capabilitiesUnavailable: Installed language readiness could not be verified. Language changes are disabled; existing settings are preserved.

announcements.title: Caller audio and announcements
announcements.description: Configure hold audio and periodic spoken updates for callers waiting in this queue.
announcements.holdMediaHelp: Choose account media or an installed system prompt to play while the caller waits. Existing custom media is preserved.
announcements.preConnectMediaHelp: Optional audio played once to the caller after an agent is selected and before connection.
announcements.intervalHelp: Announcements repeat at this interval; Kazoo requires at least 15 seconds.
announcements.initialDelayHelp: Wait this many seconds before the first position or estimated-wait announcement. For example, 30 waits half a minute after entering the queue. Repeats use the announcement interval independently.
announcements.languageHelp: One queue language controls position announcements and every callback offer, menu, number readback, confirmation and error response, using its built-in female voice. New queues default to English. Saving a ready language uses its built-in prompts. Unavailable languages cannot be selected; existing unavailable settings survive unrelated edits. Synthetic voice availability does not imply native-speaker pronunciation approval.
announcements.promptsDescription: Choose audio used around the spoken queue position and estimated wait time. Only verified installed system prompts and account media are offered.
announcements.legacyPromptsPreserved: This queue has custom announcement or callback audio. Saving with a ready queue language replaces those queue prompt overrides with its built-in voice, even when the language is unchanged. Your recordings are not deleted. If the selected language is unavailable, unrelated edits preserve the current settings.

callbacks.title: Callback registrations
callbacks.description: Review and cancel account-scoped callback registrations for
callbacks.configurationDescription: Disabled by default. Callers can request a place-preserving callback. Select the user whose calling permissions and caller ID should be used; the server rechecks them before every attempt.
callbacks.announcementTimingHelp: Schedule the callback option separately from queue-position and estimated-wait announcements. Their timing settings are unchanged.
callbacks.announcementDisabledHelp: Turning this announcement off silences the callback offer only. Callers can still use the callback entry key while virtual callback is enabled.
callbacks.keysHelp: The callback entry key must differ from the queue exit key and fixed confirmation key 1. Alternate-number entry uses key 2 only when enabled.
callbacks.keyConflict: Callback entry, confirmation, alternate-number, and queue exit keys must not conflict.
callbacks.authorityHelp: Choose a user by name. The user's current caller ID is used automatically unless you choose an account-number override. Existing legacy device selections are preserved.
callbacks.localResourcesHelp: Use only resources owned by this account. The server derives the account scope from the authenticated request.
callbacks.mediaDescription: Optional audio overrides. Use default keeps the language-aware system prompts; the return confirmation always requires DTMF 1.
callbacks.privacyNotice: Callback numbers, original call IDs, live leg IDs, and private leases are intentionally not returned by this API.
callbacks.reconciliationGeneric: Call state is being verified; no new attempt will be placed.

reconciliationReasons.engine_restart: The call engine restarted; current channel state is being verified.
reconciliationReasons.owner_lost: The prior callback worker stopped; its call state is being verified.
reconciliationReasons.channel_snapshot_incomplete: Not every call engine returned a complete channel snapshot.
reconciliationReasons.originate_pending: The outbound request is still being reconciled.
reconciliationReasons.cleanup_pending: Call cleanup is in progress and awaiting confirmation.
reconciliationReasons.bridge_proof_pending: A possible bridge is awaiting call-center agent verification.

callbacks.confirmCancel: Cancel this callback registration? An active outbound attempt enters cancelling state until its exact call leg is cleaned up.
callbacks.emptyDescription: This queue has no callback registrations on this page.

fields.name: Name
fields.enterEmpty: Allow callers to enter when no agents are available
fields.positionAnnouncements: Speak the caller's current queue position
fields.callbackAnnouncementEnabled: Announce the callback option while callers wait
fields.callbackAllowAlternate: Allow callers to enter an alternate callback number (key 2)
